description: Reads the Game tab as the server serves it (GET /api/tirage): today's draw (tickets, closing time, practice or paid mode), the live preview face (the face the latest Base block would draw), yesterday's revealed day, the BlockRolls contract when one is served (prices, prizes, pot) or null (practice: free rolls, nothing to sign), and the recent off-chain practice rolls (GET /api/jeu/rolls). With `wallet`: that wallet's ticket (held or not, verified volume, skin pass), its ticket face as the 5-trait guess tblock_plan_roll uses by default, and its entries in this week's and month's draws. Read-only.

wallet.description: Optional: the wallet whose ticket and progress to read.

name: tblock_game_state
title: Read the Game: today's draw, your ticket, the rolls
